rules.statement: In proceedings under section 327 of the Code, once a petition is numbered as a plaint, the burden of establishing possession or the right to possess falls on the judgment creditor.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am definitely of the view that once a petition has been numbered as a plaint the onus of establishing possession or the right to possess is upon the judgment creditor who, as against the claimant, has all the obligations which the law casts upon a 'plaintiff in a regular action."
